claire: Quick console accessibility notes from a short NVDA + Firefox pass. Keeping it tight so eng can triage. omar: please drop the list thx claire: findings by area: 1) Streaming announcer: current aria-live fires for every chunk/token -> NVDA interrupts typing and reading. Suggest switching to visual-per-token but SR summary only (role=status) on milestones or completion. 2) Toggle groups (small pill toggles) use a 1px focus outline + shadow; at 2x zoom the visible focus disappears. Need a stronger focus-visible token (3px) and ensure high-contrast around dark bg. 3) Modal keyboard shortcut help (press ?) opens a modal. When closed via Escape, focus sometimes lands in document body not back on the help trigger. Likely missing focus restore call. 4) Table rows: expand chevron has no accessible name, NVDA announces "button collapsed" without context. Should be `aria-label="Expand {modelName} row"`. 5) Decorative inline svgs in metric cards are being read by SR. Add aria-hidden="true" to decorative SVGs. ux_lina: on streaming announcer UX: I prefer announcing only on completion and errors. Example: "Generation complete: 128 tokens" as the single SR message. Visual real-time stream is fine. vikram: okay for implementation notes: - Announcer: keep an offscreen
and update it only on complete/error. Avoid per-token updates. - Focus ring: update token `--focus-ring` to 3px and add outline-offset: 2px for pills. - Modal restore: ensure `trigger.focus()` in close handler and add e2e keyboard test. - Chevron: use `aria-label={`Expand row for ${model.name}`}` on the toggle button. - SVG: add `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative svgs. dev_zoe: i'll split into two PRs: 1) announcer + e2e for streaming scenario, 2) focus token + modal focus restore + aria-labels. Will link drafts by EOD. claire: small example snippets for the PRs: ```js // announcer update on completion const announcer = document.getElementById('gen-announcer'); announcer.textContent = `Generation complete: ${tokenCount} tokens.`; ``` ```css /* pill focus */ .pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: none; } ``` a11y-bot: Automated scan results: 5 issues. Severity: 2 high (live-region flooding, focus restore), 3 medium (focus visibility, missing aria-names, decorative svg reading). Full report: /internal/a11y/reports/1931234567 omar: prioritization: live-region + modal focus restore as P0. focus token + aria labels P1. decorative svgs P2. ux_lina: agree. Also suggest copy tweak for chevron tooltip from "Expand" to "Expand row for {modelName}" so SR and hover match. dev_zoe: noted. i'll include copy change in aria-label and tooltip attributes. claire: i'll re-run a quick NVDA check after merges and post a one-line verification. thanks team :pray:
